question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: KeynoteHall_Stage showed the most extreme contrast: peak_hc 500 vs overnight_avg 7.085 on 2025-12-08 (overnight = 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-08T06:00:00Z), giving ratio 70.57163020465772. The order_of_magnitude is 1.0, i.e., the peak is on the order of 10^1 (tens) times the overnight baseline.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)
WHERE c.camera_location IN ['ExpoFloor_MainAisle','DemoBooth_NVIDIA','DemoBooth_Intel','KeynoteHall_Stage','FoodCourt_North']
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH c.camera_location AS camera_location,
     max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc,
     avg(CASE WHEN ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T06:00:00Z' THEN ch.avg_hc END) AS overnight_avg
WITH camera_location, peak_hc, overnight_avg,
     CASE WHEN overnight_avg > 0 THEN toFloat(peak_hc) / overnight_avg ELSE NULL END AS ratio
WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
RETURN camera_location, peak_hc, overnight_avg, ratio,
       CASE WHEN ratio > 0 THEN floor(log(ratio)/log(10)) ELSE NULL END AS order_of_magnitude
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 1
